text:
Raj: CloudHarbor asked for a joint co-sell trial that tests Hosted + a short Dedicated burst. Need an ops + legal checklist and a simple cost comparison for procurement by Friday.
cloudharbor-poc: Prefer a hybrid trial so we can validate latency with our on-prem connector. Also want short-lived embed tokens for dev.
Maya: Quick answers: we can provision a shared tenant that mimics Hosted behavior and allow a Dedicated burst for a week. No prod keys. We'll provide scoped ephemeral tokens for embeds/generation.
Connor: Network note: for the on-prem connector we need their firewall to allow outbound to our NAT IPs and to accept the connector's inbound if they choose reverse-tunnel. Which egress IPs do they need?
legal-bot: legal: need completed partner DPA + mutual NDA on file for any PII processing. Also highlight our standard data retention and deletion SLA for pilots. Link to templates: https://redwood.internal/legal/partner-templates (internal).
Raj: Security: will we allow them to bring their KMS for the Dedicated burst?
Maya: KMS only supported in Private deployments. For Dedicated we can offer host-managed encryption with attestations and audit logs. We'll document mitigation.
Connor: Ops: plan A = Hosted sandpit + ephemeral tokens. Plan B = spin up 1-week Dedicated pool (1xA10 equiv) and route test traffic to it. Example token mint: ``POST /admin/partners/{id}/tokens {"ttl":3600,"scopes":["embed:write","generate:limited"]}``. Tokens are audited.
cloudharbor-poc: Procurement also wants a simple cost delta: "Hosted pilot cost vs Dedicated week".
Maya: Ballpark: Hosted pilot = pilot credits (no charge) 100k gen + 4k embed units. Dedicated week (1xA10 eq) = ~$10k/week including support. I'll confirm exact number with finance.
legal-bot: Also request: which data categories are logged for the sandbox? We log request metadata, token usage, and retention is 30 days by default for pilot sandboxes. Add opt-in for extended retention with approval.
Raj: I'll assemble the runbook: provisioning steps, entitlement template, SAML checklist, NAT IPs (Connor to post), token example, legal templates link, and cost ballpark. Target to send to partner tomorrow AM and schedule joint test.
Connor: Allocated NAT IPs: [3.17.45.12, 3.17.45.13]. Dedicated pool prep started (req=99821).
cloudharbor-poc: We'll send IdP metadata + primary tech contact today and confirm preferred pilot dates.
Maya: I'll upload canned security answers and the entitlement template to the shared drive and DM finance for a formal quote.
Raj: Great. If CloudHarbor posts metadata here, Connor can enable SAML in test mode before the demo. Closing for now, will follow up with the runbook. :thumbsup:
